description: List projects with their open work, one line each. You rarely need this: every tool takes project as a name. Each line has the name, open counts (working, blocked, todo) and id. With project: that project's notes.

project.description: Project name, e.g. the repo folder ("api-server"). Any case, or an id. Unknown names match nothing.

name: taskhold_list_projects
title: List projects
